text: City Council on June 24 and 25, 2026, adopted Item IE30.4 and, in so doing, has requested the Toronto Parking Authority, in collaboration with the General Manager, Parks and Recreation, to complete a surface parking optimization study, assessing options for reconfiguring and greening parking lots to unlock greater park potential while meeting public needs for park access and parking through all seasons.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority received the item for information.
